status: Qualified native counted UTF8 text encoder component; full goal active and incomplete

contract.profile: Ranked BPE with complete byte alphabet, exact captured ordered number/CJK/letter-punctuation Split plus ByteLevel profile, identity normalization and non-stripping/non-single-word added tokens. Unknown semantic transforms reject initialization.
contract.ownership: Encoder owns immutable sorted vocabulary/merge metadata and added-token trie; strings borrow a caller-owned immutable JSON document that must outlive encoder use. Host budget covers owned metadata, excludes JSON/parser allocator overhead and static program data.
contract.workspace: Caller starts with zeroed encoder and scratch handles. One caller-owned bounded block with byte-indexed nodes, priority heap and staged token results. Independent scratch per concurrent request; no initialized handle copies.
contract.algorithm: Per-piece ranked min-heap, lazy version invalidation and leftmost rank ties; O(n log n) BPE rather than quadratic rescans. Added-token longest matching precedes model splits. In-place construction heapsorts avoid hidden sort allocations.
contract.failure: Malformed UTF8, insufficient output or input capacity, direct input/handle/workspace/metadata aliases and unsupported setup reject without changing caller outputs/written or publishing a partial handle. Caller must provide valid memory spans and disjoint borrowed document storage.
contract.raw_tokens: Counted valid UTF8 including NUL. No BOS/EOS/chat-template insertion; IDs match Rust encode(add_special_tokens=false). Diagnostic split API excludes added-vocabulary isolation, matching pre_tokenize_str.
contract.legacy: Existing GGUF tokenizer API/representation unchanged; no new GPU kernels, model architecture changes or default inference-path acceleration.

reference.method: Independent pinned Rust tokenizers, no candidate imports. Includes every checkpoint vocabulary token decoded by Rust and re-encoded as text, added-token contexts, random/curated text and long prompts. Full source pre-tokenizer replay plus categories captured separately from source Regex.
reference.category_flags: All Unicode scalars classified through independent Rust Regex removals for L/M/N/P/S/whitespace; generated immutable C table is replay-checked.
reference.unit_capture: 24 independently captured synthetic cases plus133 ASCII-prefix/mark-tail regressions; source also checks equivalent string/array merge serialization
reference.guards: Wrong package version, checkpoint hash and conflicting existing payload reject without overwrite.

validation.del_edge: Preliminary candidate incorrectly admitted DEL into ASCII punctuation; source diagnostic observed2pieces vs1. Fixed upper bound, added133 source-captured ASCII-prefix/mark-tail tests and a full actual-vocabulary edge replay; all earlier oracle values preserved.

qualification.scope: Native bounded JSON byte BPE encoder for exact supported Split/ByteLevel profile, immutable model metadata, explicit request-local heap workspace, added isolation, strict valid counted UTF8 including NUL; independent Rust all-vocabulary text and full-scalar context references, OOM/no-hot-heap/ASAN/UBSAN/TSAN/thread qualification, unchanged native-forward and strict Qwen controls. No streaming decoder, chat/template/native CLI admission or vLLM parity claim.

validation.encoder_constructor_faults: Both allocation points reject atomically and leak-free; one-byte-short model/request budgets reject. Constructor uses in-place sorts.
validation.asan_ubsan: All new JSON/tokenizer/probe C code instrumented; passed full actual/synthetic replay, negative units and two-worker shared encoder.
validation.threadsanitizer: All new JSON/tokenizer/probe C code instrumented; two workers, one immutable encoder, independent scratch/output, complete actual case partition and source IDs passed without races.
validation.reference_replay: Both initial and long corpora regenerated byte-identically; generated Unicode and unit headers unchanged.
validation.native_control: Existing source-indexed DeepSeek full forward: fresh513/resume513/5 self-fed steps,14 exact GPUhalf/CPUfloat checks,5429760 bytes. Does not yet feed the new text encoder into inference.
validation.qwen27: Fresh strict192/192 sampled IDs,0/8 count mismatch,147/147 word prefixes
validation.scope: No new GPU operations or GPU sanitizer claim; full CUDA suite/diagnostics run as compatibility checks.

memory.scope: Owned payload admission only, excludes borrowed JSON storage, allocator overhead and program/static data. No per-call heap growth.
